headline: Record production and profit; full-year guidance raised
summary_short: Diamondback Energy reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $5.56 billion, up 51.3% year-over-year, with GAAP diluted EPS of $6.65 and net income of $1.88 billion, as oil production reached 525 MBO/d and total output topped 1.0 million BOE/d for the first time.
summary_long: Revenue rose 51.3% y/y to $5.56 billion on higher realized oil prices ($96.82/bbl vs $63.23/bbl) and record output above 1.0 MMBOE/d. GAAP net income was $1.88 billion ($6.65/diluted share, +179.4% y/y), boosted by a $134 million gain on debt extinguishment; adjusted net income was $1.83 billion ($6.48/share). Free cash flow reached $2.33 billion (operating cash flow $3.6 billion less $996 million capex). The company bought back $141 million of stock, declared a $1.10/share dividend, cut debt ~$1.3 billion q/q to $12.8 billion, and doubled its buyback authorization to $16.0 billion. Diamondback raised 2026 oil guidance to 522+ MBO/d and total volumes to 1,000+ MBOE/d, holding capex at ~$3.9 billion.

drivers.explanation: Revenue growth is fully consistent with the release's own price and volume tables: realized oil price +53% y/y ($96.82 vs $63.23/bbl) combined with production above 1.0 MMBOE/d for the first time.
Profit growth was aided by a $134 million gain on extinguishment of debt recorded in other income, on top of the underlying revenue increase.
Net income growth reflects the revenue increase plus a lower diluted share count (281.2M vs 292.1M a year ago) following ongoing buybacks.
Not explained in the release beyond the headline production figures; no specific well or basin driver was cited for the y/y increase.
Release frames the quarter around crossing 1.0 MMBOE/d, cutting debt ~$1.3 billion q/q, doubling the buyback authorization to $16.0 billion, and raising full-year production guidance.
